dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Steady, symmetrical narrowing of the body width initiating from the mid-section and extending toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth and continuous lateral margins with no observed asymmetrical bulges or structural indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-reflectance skin tone across the entirety of the visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, high-contrast dark circular aperture at the anterior dorsal midline (blowhole); presence of low-contrast, fine linear streaks on the lateral-dorsal surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint, longitudinal linear markings on the anterior-lateral surfaces, potentially representing healed rake marks or epidermal folds.
other_distinctive_markers: Noticeable bilateral narrowing posterior to the head region, indicating a defined neck structure.
